covers: INT 13h, the disk BIOS: every function the emulator's INT13_DiskHandler has a case for.

entries.name: reset disk
entries.description: Resets the disk system for the drive in DL, recalibrating its heads.
entries.behaviour: DL = drive. With no disk image mounted it succeeds; with images and an inactive drive it sets CF and the last status to 01h, except on CGA, Amstrad, PCjr, Olivetti and 3270 PC machines, which succeed if floppy 0 or 1 is active. Otherwise it resets the IDE or floppy emulation and clears CF; AH is never written.
entries.differs: The list returns AH=00h on success; the emulator leaves AH unchanged.

entries.name: get last status
entries.description: Returns the status of the last disk operation.
entries.behaviour: Returns the single global last status, whatever DL is: if it is not 00h, AH = that status and CF is set, otherwise AH=00h and CF is clear. Reading it does not clear it. Several functions (AH=04h to 07h, 11h, 17h, 41h, 44h) leave it unchanged on success.

entries.name: read sectors
entries.description: Reads AL sectors from the CHS address in CX and DH into the buffer at ES:BX.
entries.behaviour: Floppies take an 8-bit cylinder and sector and the INT 1Eh sector size; hard disks a 10-bit cylinder, 6-bit sector, 512 bytes. AL=0 or a drive with no image gives AH=01h (FFh for a mounted fixed DOS drive), a failed sector its status, all with CF set. The first read after a floppy swap fails with AH=06h.

entries.name: write sectors
entries.description: Writes AL sectors from the buffer at ES:BX to the CHS address in CX and DH.
entries.behaviour: Registers as AH=02h, but the sector size is the INT 1Eh table's for floppies and the image's own size for hard disks. An unmounted drive returns AH=FFh and CF; a sector size over 2048 returns AH=80h; the first failed sector stops the write with its status in AH and CF set. On success AH=00h, CF clear, AL unchanged.

entries.name: verify sectors
entries.description: Verifies AL sectors at the CHS address in CX and DH without transferring data.
entries.behaviour: AL=0 returns AH=01h and CF set; an inactive drive returns AH=01h (the last status) with CF set. Otherwise the emulator reads nothing and compares nothing: it only accounts for the drive time on floppies and IDE disks, then returns AH=00h with CF clear and AL unchanged.
entries.differs: The list returns in AL the number of sectors verified and checks each sector's CRC; the emulator leaves AL unchanged and checks nothing.

entries.name: format track
entries.description: Formats a track on the drive in DL.
entries.behaviour: The emulator does nothing to the disk and logs a warning that the call is ignored. An inactive drive returns AH=FFh with CF set; any other returns AH=00h with CF clear, for floppies after accounting for the format time. ES:BX and the interleave are not read.

entries.description: Formats a track and sets the bad sector flags on a fixed disk (XT only in the list).
entries.behaviour: The emulator ignores the format and logs a warning. An inactive drive returns AH=FFh with CF set; any other drive, floppy or hard, returns AH=00h with CF clear. No data is written and no time is accounted.

entries.name: get drive params
entries.description: Returns the geometry of the drive in DL and the number of drives.
entries.behaviour: AX=0, BL = floppy BIOS type (0 for hard disks), CH and CL = maximum cylinder and sector, DH = maximum head, DL = mounted drives of that kind (cylinders less any reserved). Floppies also return ES:DI -> the emulator's own table. An inactive DL=00h returns fixed 1.44M values, any other inactive drive AH=07h with CF.
entries.differs: For an unmounted floppy 0 the list says error; the emulator succeeds with fixed 1.44M values (BL=4, CH=79, CL=18, DH=1, DL=1).

entries.name: seek
entries.description: Seeks the hard disk in DL to the cylinder in CH and CL.
entries.behaviour: A floppy DL returns AH=01h with CF set. An inactive hard disk sets CF and the last status without writing AH. Otherwise only the IDE emulation accounts for the seek time; the call returns AH=00h with CF clear and moves nothing.

entries.name: recalibrate
entries.description: Recalibrates the hard disk in DL, seeking it to cylinder 0.
entries.behaviour: The emulator does not look at DL beyond a hard disk on the IDE emulation, which accounts for the recalibrate time. It always returns AH=00h with CF clear, even for an unmounted drive or a floppy, and does not set the last status.

entries.name: get disk type
entries.description: Returns the type of the drive in DL and, for a hard disk, its size in sectors.
entries.behaviour: With images: an inactive drive gives AH=07h, CF set; floppies AH=2 if change detect is on and the BIOS type is 2 or more, else 1; hard disks AH=3 and CX:DX = sectors (the byte size wraps at 4 GiB). With none: a floppy gives AH=2 or 1, a mounted DOS drive AH=3 and CX:DX=0003:4800h, else AH=FFh with CF.

entries.name: detect disk change
entries.description: Reports whether the floppy in DL was changed since the last call.
entries.behaviour: With the 'int 13 disk change detect' option off it returns AH=FFh, CF set. Otherwise an inactive drive gives AH=80h with CF; a floppy whose flag is set gives AH=06h with CF and clears the flag, else AH=00h and CF clear; a hard disk always gives AH=06h with CF.

entries.name: set format type
entries.description: Sets the floppy disk type for a following format.
entries.behaviour: AL and DL are not read. The emulator only arms a one-shot flag and returns AH=00h with CF clear: the next sector read (AH=02h or 42h) transfers no data and fails once with AH=04h, after which reads work normally.
entries.differs: The list sets the media type for formatting from AL; the emulator ignores AL and arms a single failing read instead.

entries.name: check extensions
entries.description: Checks whether the INT 13 extensions are present for the drive in DL.
entries.behaviour: If BX=55AAh and the drive is active: AH=01h, BX=AA55h, CX=0001h (functions 42h to 44h, 47h, 48h), CF clear, DH unset. Otherwise CF is set and AH is not written. With the 'int 13 extensions' option off, AH=40h to 48h return AH=FFh with CF set.
entries.differs: The list returns AH=01h on failure; the emulator leaves AH unchanged.

entries.name: extended read
entries.description: Reads blocks from an LBA given by the disk address packet at DS:SI.
entries.behaviour: The packet must be 10h bytes with reserved byte, high sector dword and count in order (count non-zero), else AH=01h with CF. Each block copies only 512 bytes (2048 on an El Torito no-emulation drive). A failed block sets CF, AH = its status and the packet's count to the blocks done; an inactive drive gives AH=FFh.
entries.differs: The list allows a packet of 18h bytes with a 64-bit flat buffer; the emulator refuses it with AH=01h.

entries.name: extended write
entries.description: Writes blocks to an LBA given by the disk address packet at DS:SI.
entries.behaviour: AL (write flags) is ignored, so no verify is done. An inactive drive returns AH=FFh; a bad packet or zero count returns AH=01h. Each block takes the image's own sector size from the buffer, not 512; the first failed block returns its status in AH with CF set.
entries.differs: The list sets the packet's block count to the blocks transferred on error; the emulator never writes the count here.

entries.name: extended verify
entries.description: Verifies blocks at the LBA given by the disk address packet at DS:SI.
entries.behaviour: An inactive drive returns AH=FFh with CF set. Otherwise the emulator verifies nothing: for an IDE disk with a valid packet it only accounts for the drive time. It returns AH=00h with CF clear and leaves the packet's count untouched.
entries.differs: The list checks the blocks and writes the number verified into the packet; the emulator checks nothing and writes nothing.

entries.name: ext get drive params
entries.description: Fills the buffer at DS:SI with the extended drive parameters of the drive in DL.
entries.behaviour: An inactive drive or a buffer size under 1Ah returns AH=FFh with CF set. Written: flags 0003h, cylinders, heads and sectors as dwords, total sectors (capped at 0FFFFFFFh unless 48-bit LBA is on) and 512 bytes per sector, always. A size over 1Eh returns 1Eh bytes with the FFFFFFFFh EDD pointer; 1Ah to 1Eh returns 1Ah bytes.
entries.differs: The list sizes a v2.x call at 1Eh and returns the EDD pointer; the emulator, given exactly 1Eh, returns the 1Ah-byte v1.x form without it.

entries.name: cd emulation status
entries.description: Gets the bootable CD-ROM emulation status, or terminates the emulation.
entries.behaviour: Only for DL=7Fh or the El Torito no-emulation drive, with AL=0 or 1, else AH=FFh with CF. It fills the 13h-byte packet at DS:SI: size 13h, media type 00h (no emulation) plus 40h on IDE, drive number, IDE controller and slave bit, and returns AH=00h with CF clear. AL=00h and 01h act alike and no emulation is ended.
